spans.s:
(ऋ) फेलृ r. 10th cl. (फेलति)
To go or move.

f. (-ला)
Orts, leavings.
E.
फेल to go, अच् aff., fem. aff. टाप्; also फेलक and फेलि.

m. (-कः)
Orts, leavings of a meal, or droppings from the mouth.
E.
फेल to go, वुन् aff.

f. (-लिः or ली)
Orts, leavings.
E.
फेल to go, इन् aff., ङीप् optionally added; also with टाप् and कन् added, फेलिका f. (-का)
